{{Quote|Congratulations. That was a fine race you won, and that is a fine speeder. My name is Zebulon Dak.|Zebulon Dak|<ref name="ARttF" />}}
'''Zebulon Dak''' was the wealthy, influential founder and owner of [[Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation/Legends|Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. A follower of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] racing, Dak attended races in search of new talent and was so impressed by racer [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben's]] performance in the [[Boonta Speeder Race]] in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]] that he offered full-time jobs to both Joben and his racing partner, [[Jord Dusat]]. However, Dak was secretly involved in early resistance to the Empire, using his wealth and success as a cover for his activities, and also recruited the young racers' friend, [[Kea Moll]], to assist in his work.

==Biography==
{{Quote|I want you two to work for me. Designing, and building. Um&hellip; when can you start?|Zebulon Dak, to Thall Joben and Jord Dusat|<ref name="ARttF" />}}
Zebulon Dak made his name as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]]<ref name="TotGD">''[[C-3PO: Tales of the Golden Droid]]''</ref> and [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]] magnate around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Polyhedron">{{PolyhedronCite|170|Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO}}</ref> He founded the [[Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation/Legends|Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation]]<ref name="CSWE" /> at some point prior to [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]],<ref name="15BBY">"[[Star Wars Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]" in ''[[Polyhedron 170]]'' states that [[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO|''Star Wars: Droids'']] is set 15 years before [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']]. ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' places the events of '' A New Hope'' in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]], meaning that ''Star Wars: Droids'' takes place in [[15 BBY/Legends|15 BBY]].</ref> and the company's success made him wealthy and influential. However, unbeknownst to most, Dak was also part of an early anti-Imperial resistance cell, using his wealth and success as cover for his work to subvert the Empire.<ref name="Polyhedron" />

An enthusiast of [[Repulsorcraft/Legends|repulsorcraft]] racing, Dak attended the [[Boonta Eve Classic/Legends|Boonta Eve Classic]],<ref name="Polyhedron" /> [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine's]] annual [[Podracing/Legends|podracing]] event,<ref name="DB">{{DB|organization|boontapodrace|Boonta Eve Classic Podracers}}</ref> around [[35 BBY/Legends|35 BBY]], where he witnessed the [[Dug/Legends|Dug]] [[Sebulba/Legends|Sebulba]] [[Threading the needle|thread]] the [[Stone Needle/Legends|Stone Needle]] in [[Beggar's Canyon/Legends|Beggar's Canyon]]. In 15 BBY,<ref name="15BBY" /> Dak attended the [[Boonta Speeder Race]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Boonta/Legends|Boonta]] and witnessed the victory of racer [[Thall Joben/Legends|Thall Joben]] in the ''[[White Witch]]'',<ref name="ARttF" /> a [[Mobquet Swoops and Speeders/Legends|Mobquet]] [[C/L-82 landspeeder]] that had been heavily modified by Joben and his [[Joben-Dusat Racing Team|racing partner]], [[Jord Dusat]].<ref name="Polyhedron" /> Not only did Joben defeat his opponents in the race, but he also managed to evade the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], who followed Joben into the race after being [[Bounty/Legends|hired]] to kill the young [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] by the [[Crime lord/Legends|gangster]] [[Sise Fromm]].<ref name="ARttF" />

[[File:DakJobenDusat-ARttF.png|thumb|left|250px|Dak meets the Joben-Dusat Racing Team]]
Dak was impressed by Joben's expert flying, which reminded him of Sebulba's performance two [[Standard year/Legends|decades]] earlier,<ref name="Polyhedron" /> and approached Joben and Dusat following the race to offer them jobs designing and building speeders for Zebulon Dak Speeder Corporation. The pair accepted immediately, agreeing to start work the following day.<ref name="ARttF" /> Dak also offered employment to the racers' friend, the resistance fighter [[Kea Moll]]. Neither suspected that his true intentions were to recruit Moll to [[Spy/Legends|spy]] on [[Balmorran Arms/Legends|Balmorran Arms]], [[Millennium Astro-Engineering]], and other manufacturers working for the Empire.<ref name="Polyhedron" /> The young engineers later reconsidered their acceptance after realizing that company policy required their [[Droid/Legends|droids]], [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], to be reprogrammed and [[Memory wipe/Legends|wiped]] of their personalities. Only when the droids decided to leave rather than hold their masters back were the two able to start their new jobs.<ref name="ARttF" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|You're sure Zebulon won't let Artoo and Threepio go along?''"<br />"''Impossible. It's company policy. They'd have to be re-programmed.|Kea Moll and Thall Joben|<ref name="ARttF" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] with [[Color/Legends|Gray]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]],<ref name="ARttF" /> Zebulon Dak's successful business allowed him to become a prominent figure in the landspeeder industry and brought him great wealth.<ref name="CSWE" /> He enjoyed repulsorcraft racing and personally attended races to look for talented racers and engineers,<ref name="ARttF" /> witnessing Sebulba in the Boonta Eve Classic<ref name="Polyhedron" /> and Thall Joben's victory in the Boonta Speeder Race.<ref name="ARttF" /> However, Dak had an almost paranoid disliking of droids that contributed to his reputation as an eccentric.<ref name="TotGD" /> His company had a strict policy of reprogramming the droids of all employees, which almost led Joben and Dusat to reject his job offer.<ref name="ARttF" /> Unbeknownst to most, Dak was opposed to Imperial rule and used his position as a cover for his work to subvert the Empire.<ref name="Polyhedron" />

==Behind the scenes==
Zebulon Dak was created for the [[Nelvana]] animated series ''[[Star Wars: Droids: The Adventures of R2-D2 and C-3PO]]'' and made his only appearance in the fourth episode, "[[A Race to the Finish]],"<ref name="ARttF" /> written by [[Peter Sauder]] and [[Steven Wright]] and first broadcast on [[September 28]], [[1985]].<ref name="Insider27">{{InsiderCite|27|A Star Wars CELibration|A ''Star Wars'' CELibration}}</ref>
